_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11027 - `lib.js` is a CommonJS entry, so its chunk exports the whole `module.exports` value. The optimizer treated it as an export-less entry and folded the runtime and `shared.js` into it, then rendered each extra export as another `module.exports =`. In non-ESM formats such a chunk must not get extra exports, and under `exports-only` it must not get extra exports in any format.
